Job Openings and Labor Turnover Summary

For release 10:00 a.m. (ET) Tuesday, November 3, 2026 USDL-26-1630
JOB OPENINGS AND LABOR TURNOVER — SEPTEMBER 2026
The number of job openings was little changed at 7.5 million in September.
The number and rate of job openings were little changed at 7.5 million and 4.5 percent, respectively, in September.
August 2026 Revisions
The number of job openings for August was revised up by 111,000 to 7.2 million.
